Contact: +91 90621 50656 Gaya Station to Bharat Sevashram: 1KM EASY Walk (No Rickshaw Needed!)
Planning your Pind Daan pilgrimage to Gaya? Many Bengali pilgrims and others seek accommodation at Bharat Sevashram Sangha. If you're arriving at Gaya Railway Station (Gaya Junction), save money and hassle with this simple 1KM walking guide!
This video shows you the EASIEST way to walk from Gaya Station directly to Bharat Sevashram Sangha. Forget expensive rickshaws or confusing routes. I'll guide you step-by-step, highlighting key landmarks along the way, ensuring a smooth and stress-free journey.
